# Count the number of hospitals per city
hospitals_per_city = df['City'].value_counts()

# Find the city with the maximum count
max_hospitals = hospitals_per_city.max()
city_with_most_hospitals = hospitals_per_city[hospitals_per_city == max_hospitals].index.tolist()

# If there is a tie, return all cities with the maximum count
answer = city_with_most_hospitals[0] if len(city_with_most_hospitals) == 1 else city_with_most_hospitals
